verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a Fly Machines REST API, but nothing shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable spec, and the probe found all candidate OpenAPI/Swagger paths returning 404. Having a REST API is related but is not the same as publishing a machine-readable spec, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
